class Helper
{
    static $MULTI_TCs = false;
    internal $separatorAutoString;

    public static function __stdioMain()
    {
        $cnt = self::$MULTI_TCs ? intval(trim(fgets(STDIN))) : 1;
        for ($i = 1; $i <= $cnt; $i++) {
            $sol = new Solution();
            $sol->__main($i);
        }
    }

    internal function writeLine()
    {
        echo PHP_EOL;
    }

    internal function writeSeparator()
    {
        if (!empty($this->separatorAutoString)) {
            echo $this->separatorAutoString;
        }
    }

    internal function writeText($c)
    {
        echo $c;
        $this->writeSeparator();
    }

    internal function writeNumber($num)
    {
        echo $num;
        $this->writeSeparator();
    }

    static function EOF()
    {
        throw new Exception("EndOfStream");
    }

    static function stream()
    {
        while (!feof(STDIN)) {
            $c = fgetc(STDIN);
            if ($c === false) break;
            yield $c;
        }
    }

    static function isWhitespace($c)
    {
        return $c === ' ' || $c === "\n" || $c === "\r" || $c === "\t";
    }

    static $sb = '';

    internal static function readWordString()
    {
        self::$sb = '';
        $iter = [];
        $gen = self::stream();
        $started = false;
        foreach ($gen as $c) {
            if (!$started) {
                if (!self::isWhitespace($c)) {
                    $started = true;
                    $iter[] = $c;
                }
            } else {
                if (self::isWhitespace($c)) {
                    break;
                } else {
                    $iter[] = $c;
                }
            }
        }
        foreach ($iter as $c) {
            self::$sb .= $c;
        }
        if (strlen(self::$sb) === 0) self::EOF();
        return self::$sb;
    }

    internal static function readLong64()
    {
        return intval(self::readWordString());
    }

    internal static function readSingleChar()
    {
        $gen = self::stream();
        foreach ($gen as $c) {
            if (!self::isWhitespace($c)) return $c;
        }
        self::EOF();
    }

    internal static function seq($low, $high, $skip = 1)
    {
        $res = [];
        for ($i = $low; $i <= $high; $i += $skip) {
            $res[] = $i;
        }
        return $res;
    }

    internal static function rev($low, $high, $skipPositive = 1)
    {
        $res = [];
        for ($i = $high; $i >= $low; $i -= $skipPositive) {
            $res[] = $i;
        }
        return $res;
    }

    internal static function countLength($left, $right)
    {
        return $left > $right ? 0 : ($right - $left + 1);
    }

    internal static function getRight($left, $count)
    {
        return $left + $count - 1;
    }

    internal static function getLeft($count, $right)
    {
        return $right - $count + 1;
    }
}

class ValueRefPointer
{
    public $ValueNullable = null;

    public function IfAbsent($init)
    {
        if ($this->ValueNullable === null) $init($this);
        return $this;
    }

    public function UpdateIfAbsent($calc)
    {
        if ($this->ValueNullable === null) $this->ValueNullable = $calc();
        return $this;
    }

    public function UpdateCompute($other, $merge_CHECKED)
    {
        $ans = $other;
        if ($this->ValueNullable !== null) {
            $ans = $merge_CHECKED($other, $this->ValueNullable);
        }
        $this->ValueNullable = $ans;
        return $this;
    }

    public function UpdateComputeNullable($other, $merge_CHECKED)
    {
        if ($other !== null) $this->UpdateCompute($other, $merge_CHECKED);
        return $this;
    }

    public function Swap($with)
    {
        $temp = $this->ValueNullable;
        $this->ValueNullable = $with->ValueNullable;
        $with->ValueNullable = $temp;
        return $this;
    }

    public function __toString()
    {
        return strval($this->ValueNullable);
    }
}

source_data.prob_desc_description: You are given a string s consisting of n lowercase Latin letters. You have to type this string using your keyboard.Initially, you have an empty string. Until you type the whole string, you may perform the following operation:  add a character to the end of the string. Besides, at most once you may perform one additional operation: copy the string and append it to itself.For example, if you have to type string abcabca, you can type it in 7 operations if you type all the characters one by one. However, you can type it in 5 operations if you type the string abc first and then copy it and type the last character.If you have to type string aaaaaaaaa, the best option is to type 4 characters one by one, then copy the string, and then type the remaining character.Print the minimum number of operations you need to type the given string.
source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: Print one integer number — the minimum number of operations you need to type the given string.
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The first line of the input containing only one integer number n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100) — the length of the string you have to type. The second line containing the string s consisting of n lowercase Latin letters.
source_data.prob_desc_notes: NoteThe first test described in the problem statement.In the second test you can only type all the characters one by one.
